comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.description: Compare values across categories and rank them.

trend.name: Trends & time
trend.description: Show how values change over time.

composition.name: Composition
composition.description: Break a total into its parts.

statistical.name: Statistical
statistical.description: Confidence intervals, control limits and diagnostics.

flow.name: Flow & hierarchy
flow.description: Follow quantities between stages and levels.

geo.name: Maps
geo.description: Plot values by country or coordinates.

dimensional.name: Dimensional
dimensional.description: Reduce and explore many variables at once.

bar.name: Bar chart
bar.howToRead: Each bar's length is the value for that category; compare heights to rank them.

grouped_bar.name: Grouped bar
grouped_bar.howToRead: Bars sit side by side within each category so you can compare sub-groups directly.

stacked_bar.name: Stacked bar
stacked_bar.description: Totals with the contribution of each sub-group.
stacked_bar.howToRead: Each bar is a total; the coloured segments show how much each sub-group contributes.

percent_stacked_bar.name: 100% stacked bar
percent_stacked_bar.description: Share of each sub-group within every category.
percent_stacked_bar.howToRead: Every bar adds up to 100%, so segment heights show the mix within each category.

lollipop.name: Lollipop chart
lollipop.description: A lighter bar chart for ranked values.
lollipop.howToRead: The dot marks each category's value; the longer the stick, the larger the value.

dot_plot.name: Dot plot
dot_plot.description: Compare several measures per category as dots.
dot_plot.howToRead: Each dot is one measure for a category; dots further right are larger.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell chart
dumbbell.description: Show the gap between two measures per category.
dumbbell.howToRead: The two dots are the start and end values; a green bar means it rose, red that it fell.

radar.name: Radar chart
radar.description: Profile several measures for a few items.
radar.howToRead: Each spoke is a measure; a larger shape means higher values across the measures.

bullet.name: Bullet / target chart
bullet.description: Actual against target for each category.
bullet.howToRead: The dark bar is the actual value, the light bar and tick are the target; green means the target was met.

pareto.name: Pareto chart
pareto.description: Sorted bars with the cumulative share line (80/20).
pareto.howToRead: Bars are sorted largest first; the line shows the running share, so you can see which few items make up 80%.

category_heatmap.name: Heatmap table
category_heatmap.description: Colour a value across two categories.
category_heatmap.howToRead: Darker cells hold higher values for that row and column combination.

line.name: Line chart
line.description: The classic view of change over time.
line.howToRead: The line follows the value over time; slopes show growth or decline.

area.name: Area chart
area.description: Emphasise the volume of a trend.
area.howToRead: The filled area shows the value over time; its height is the amount at each date.

stacked_area.name: Stacked area
stacked_area.description: How parts of a total change over time.
stacked_area.howToRead: Layers stack on top of each other, so the top edge is the total and each band is one group.

step_line.name: Step line
step_line.description: Values that change at discrete moments (prices, stock levels).
step_line.howToRead: The value stays flat until it changes, which suits prices, stock levels and other discrete updates.

rolling_average.name: Moving average
rolling_average.description: Smooth noisy series with a rolling mean.
rolling_average.howToRead: The faint line is the raw series; the bold line averages recent points to reveal the trend.

cumulative.name: Cumulative total
cumulative.howToRead: The line adds every period to the previous total, so its slope shows how fast the total grows.

period_change.name: Period-over-period change
period_change.description: Percentage change from the previous period.
period_change.howToRead: Bars show the percentage change from the previous period: green is growth, red is decline.

candlestick.name: Candlestick
candlestick.howToRead: Each candle spans the low–high range; the body runs from open to close (green up, red down).

range_band.name: Range band
range_band.description: A line with its min–max or uncertainty band.
range_band.howToRead: The line is the value; the shaded band shows its lower and upper bounds.

calendar_heatmap.name: Calendar heatmap
calendar_heatmap.description: Weekday × week pattern of a daily measure.
calendar_heatmap.howToRead: Each square is a day; darker squares have higher values, revealing weekday and seasonal patterns.

seasonal_decompose.name: Seasonal decomposition
seasonal_decompose.description: Split a series into trend, seasonality and residual.
seasonal_decompose.howToRead: The series is split into trend (direction), seasonal (repeating pattern) and residual (noise).

autocorrelation.name: Autocorrelation (ACF / PACF)
autocorrelation.description: How a series relates to its own past values.
autocorrelation.howToRead: Bars outside the red band show lags where the series repeats itself.

pie.name: Pie chart
pie.description: Parts of a whole (best with few slices).
pie.howToRead: Each slice is a share of the whole; bigger slices are bigger shares.

donut.name: Donut chart
donut.description: A pie with room for a total in the centre.
donut.howToRead: Each segment is a share of the total shown in the centre.

treemap.name: Treemap
treemap.howToRead: Rectangle area is proportional to value; nested rectangles break a group into its parts.

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.howToRead: Inner rings are top-level groups, outer rings their sub-groups; arc length is the value.

icicle.name: Icicle chart
icicle.howToRead: Each row is a level of the hierarchy; a block's width is its share of the total.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.description: How positive and negative steps build a total.
waterfall.howToRead: Green steps add, red steps subtract, and the last bar is the resulting total.

y.help: Leave a count by choosing Count as the aggregation.

funnel.name: Funnel
funnel.howToRead: Each stage is narrower than the last; the drop between stages is where people are lost.

marimekko.name: Marimekko (mosaic)
marimekko.howToRead: Column width is each column's share of the total; segment height is the mix within it.

histogram.name: Histogram
histogram.description: How often values fall in each range.
histogram.howToRead: Bars count how many values fall in each range; the tallest bars are the most common values.

density_kde.name: Density curve (KDE)
density_kde.description: A smooth estimate of the distribution.
density_kde.howToRead: The smooth curve estimates how values are distributed; peaks are the most common values.

box.name: Box plot
box.description: Median, quartiles and outliers per group.
box.howToRead: The box holds the middle 50% of values, the line is the median, whiskers show the typical range and dots are outliers.

violin.name: Violin plot
violin.description: Box plot plus the full distribution shape.
violin.howToRead: The width at each level shows how many values sit there; the dark bar is the middle 50%.

strip.name: Strip / jitter plot
strip.description: Every observation as a dot per group.
strip.howToRead: Every dot is one row, spread sideways so overlapping values stay visible.

ecdf.name: Cumulative distribution (ECDF)
ecdf.description: Share of values below each level.
ecdf.howToRead: For any value on the x axis, the curve shows the share of values at or below it.

ridgeline.name: Ridgeline
ridgeline.howToRead: Each ridge is the distribution of one group; compare where peaks sit and how wide they are.

raincloud.name: Raincloud plot
raincloud.description: Half violin, box and raw points together.
raincloud.howToRead: Each group shows its distribution (cloud), its middle 50% (bar) and every value (rain).

mean_ci.name: Mean with confidence interval
mean_ci.howToRead: Bars are group averages and whiskers the confidence interval; overlapping whiskers mean the difference may be chance.

qq_plot.name: Q–Q plot
qq_plot.description: Check whether values follow a theoretical distribution.
qq_plot.howToRead: If points follow the red line, the data matches the chosen distribution.

distribution_fit.name: Distribution fit
distribution_fit.description: Histogram with a fitted distribution and goodness of fit.
distribution_fit.howToRead: Bars are the observed distribution; the curve is the best-fitting theoretical distribution.

control_chart.name: Control chart (SPC)
control_chart.description: Process values with mean and ±3σ control limits.
control_chart.howToRead: Points between the dashed limits are normal variation; red points outside them need attention.

bland_altman.name: Bland–Altman
bland_altman.howToRead: Each dot compares two measurements of the same thing; the lines show the average bias and limits of agreement.

missing_values.name: Missing values map
missing_values.description: Where data is missing across columns.
missing_values.howToRead: Bars show the share of blanks per column; red marks in the pattern show where they occur.

scatter.name: Scatter plot
scatter.howToRead: Each dot is one row; a rising cloud means the two measures increase together.

bubble.name: Bubble chart
bubble.description: A scatter plot with a third measure as size.
bubble.howToRead: Like a scatter plot, but bubble size shows a third measure.

regression_fit.name: Regression fit
regression_fit.description: Scatter with a fitted line, R² and equation.
regression_fit.howToRead: The curve is the fitted model and the band its 95% confidence interval; R² is the share of variation explained.

correlation_heatmap.name: Correlation matrix
correlation_heatmap.description: Correlation between every pair of measures.
correlation_heatmap.howToRead: Each cell is the correlation between two measures, from −1 (blue) to +1 (red).

scatter_matrix.name: Scatter matrix (pair plot)
scatter_matrix.description: Every pair of measures at a glance.
scatter_matrix.howToRead: Every pair of measures gets its own scatter; the diagonal shows each measure's distribution.

density_heatmap.name: 2D density heatmap
density_heatmap.howToRead: Darker cells contain more rows, which shows where points concentrate.

density_contour.name: Density contour
density_contour.howToRead: Rings enclose areas of equal point density; inner rings hold the most rows.

joint_plot.name: Joint plot
joint_plot.description: Scatter with the distribution of each axis.
joint_plot.howToRead: The scatter shows the relationship; the side histograms show each measure's distribution.

parallel_coordinates.name: Parallel coordinates
parallel_coordinates.howToRead: Each line is a row crossing every measure's axis; bundles of lines reveal common profiles.

parallel_categories.name: Parallel categories
parallel_categories.howToRead: Bands flow between category columns; their thickness is the number of rows.

crosstab_heatmap.name: Contingency table
crosstab_heatmap.description: Counts across two categories with a chi-square test.
crosstab_heatmap.howToRead: Cells count rows for each pair of categories; the chi-square test says whether they are related.

sankey.name: Sankey diagram
sankey.howToRead: Bands flow from one stage to the next; their width is the quantity moving between them.

network.name: Network graph
network.howToRead: Nodes are entities and lines are connections; bigger, darker nodes have more links.

choropleth.name: Choropleth map
choropleth.howToRead: Countries are shaded by value; darker means higher.

scatter_geo.name: Points on a map
scatter_geo.howToRead: Each point is a location plotted by latitude and longitude.

scatter_3d.name: 3D scatter
scatter_3d.howToRead: Drag to rotate; each point is a row positioned by three measures.

surface_3d.name: 3D surface
surface_3d.howToRead: The surface height and colour show the third measure across the first two; drag to rotate.

pca_2d.name: PCA map (2D)
pca_2d.description: Project many measures onto two principal components.
pca_2d.howToRead: Many measures are compressed into two components; points close together are similar rows.

pca_3d.name: PCA map (3D)
pca_3d.howToRead: Three principal components in 3D; drag to rotate and look for clusters.

pca_biplot.name: PCA biplot
pca_biplot.description: Rows and the measures that drive each component.
pca_biplot.howToRead: Points are rows and arrows are measures; arrows pointing the same way are correlated.

scree_plot.name: Scree plot
scree_plot.howToRead: Bars show how much information each component holds; the line shows the running total.

tsne_2d.name: t-SNE map
tsne_2d.description: Non-linear 2D map that keeps neighbours close.
tsne_2d.howToRead: A non-linear map that keeps similar rows together; look for separated clusters.

lda_2d.name: LDA projection
lda_2d.description: Projection that best separates labelled groups.
lda_2d.howToRead: A projection chosen to separate the labelled groups as much as possible.

kmeans_clusters.name: Cluster map (k-means)
kmeans_clusters.description: Group similar rows and show them on a PCA map.
kmeans_clusters.howToRead: Colours show the clusters found by k-means; diamonds mark each cluster's centre.

confusion_matrix.name: Confusion matrix
confusion_matrix.description: Where a classifier is right and wrong.
confusion_matrix.howToRead: The diagonal holds correct predictions; other cells show which classes get confused.

roc_curve.name: ROC curve
roc_curve.description: True vs false positive rate at every threshold, with AUC.
roc_curve.howToRead: The higher the curve sits above the diagonal, the better the model ranks positives; AUC summarises it.

pr_curve.name: Precision–recall curve
pr_curve.description: Precision and recall trade-off, with average precision.
pr_curve.howToRead: Shows the precision you keep as recall rises; higher and further right is better.

calibration_curve.name: Calibration curve
calibration_curve.description: Do predicted probabilities match observed rates?
calibration_curve.howToRead: Points on the dashed line mean predicted probabilities match observed rates.

cumulative_gain.name: Cumulative gain & lift
cumulative_gain.description: How much better than random targeting the model is.
cumulative_gain.howToRead: Shows how many positives you capture by targeting the top-scored share of rows, and the lift over random.

threshold_metrics.name: Threshold explorer
threshold_metrics.description: Precision, recall and F1 at every threshold.
threshold_metrics.howToRead: Precision, recall and F1 at every cut-off; the dotted line marks the best balance.

predicted_vs_actual.name: Predicted vs actual
predicted_vs_actual.description: Regression accuracy against the perfect line.
predicted_vs_actual.howToRead: Points on the dashed diagonal are perfect predictions; spread shows the error.

residual_plot.name: Residual plot
residual_plot.description: Errors against predictions to spot bias.
residual_plot.howToRead: Errors plotted against predictions; a random cloud around zero means no systematic bias.

error_distribution.name: Error distribution
error_distribution.howToRead: How large the prediction errors are; a narrow peak around zero is best.

feature_importance.name: Feature importance
feature_importance.description: Which inputs drive a target (random forest + permutation).
feature_importance.howToRead: Longer bars are inputs the model relies on most; whiskers show uncertainty.

learning_curve.name: Learning curve
learning_curve.description: Would more data help the model?
learning_curve.howToRead: Training and validation scores as data grows; a large gap means over-fitting.

elbow.name: Elbow chart
elbow.description: Choose the number of clusters by inertia.
elbow.howToRead: Inertia drops as clusters are added; the elbow is where extra clusters stop helping.

silhouette.name: Silhouette analysis
silhouette.howToRead: Higher bars mean better-separated clusters; the green bar is the best number of clusters.

kpi_card.name: KPI card
kpi_card.description: One headline number with its change and a sparkline.
kpi_card.howToRead: The big number is the latest period; the arrow shows the change from the period before, and the sparkline the recent trend.

gauge.name: Gauge (progress to target)
gauge.description: How far a measure is towards a target.
gauge.howToRead: The needle shows the measure against its target; green means on track, amber close, red behind.

decomposition_tree.name: Decomposition tree
decomposition_tree.description: Break a total down level by level to see where it comes from.
decomposition_tree.howToRead: Start from the total on the left and follow the branches to see which parts make it up; bigger nodes contribute more.

forecast.name: Forecast a time series
forecast.description: Project a measure forward (sales, demand, revenue) with uncertainty bands.

trend.name: Trend & seasonality analysis
trend.description: Growth rates, moving averages, seasonal patterns, change points and unusual periods.
outputs: Growth: total, average, latest and year-on-year
